'''Skull Eater''' was the name of a [[rakghoul]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] until [[3643 BBY]], when it was killed by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] individual.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Skull Eater appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an Elite enemy on the Republic version of Taris.<ref name="SWTOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
